panels.title: Chain nodes online
panels.description: Chain nodes of the monitoring inventory that answered their last scrape, counted once per host. A validator outside the inventory is not counted.

panels.title: Validators

defaults.noValue: the chain poller is not scraped

panels.description: Validators in the CometBFT set at the latest block, read by the chain poller from public RPC.

defaults.noValue: the chain poller is not scraped

panels.title: Current phase

defaults.noValue: the chain poller is not scraped

panels.description: Cycle counted from the PoC start P read from epoch_info: PoC generation, batch exchange and wait, PoC validation, validator set switch (group written at P+19, the new set signs from P+23), then inference until the next PoC.

panels.title: Until next PoC

defaults.noValue: the chain poller is not scraped

panels.description: Blocks from the current height to the next PoC start.

panels.title: Block time

defaults.noValue: no block-interval histogram in the window

panels.description: Median block interval over the last ten minutes.

panels.title: Gateways working
panels.description: Gateways whose public status reports an active DevShard.

panels.title: Endpoints failing
panels.description: Public site, API, Grafana, node RPC and LCD probes that failed their last attempt. Zero is measured; empty means nothing is probed.

panels.title: Nodes

targets.expr: topk by (host) (1, max by (host, city, country) (up{job="host",city!="",host=~"$host"}))

panels.description: One row per monitored host. GPU columns follow the GPU model filter; a host without a matching GPU keeps its row with those cells empty. A separate ML host of a validator is its own row.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle, averaged over cores.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use, excluding reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Operational disk free
panels.description: Free space on the fullest real volume of each host. The dashed lines are the 15% and 8% disk alert levels.

panels.title: GPU utilization
panels.description: Per card. Empty when no card matches the node and GPU model filters.

panels.title: GPU memory used

targets.expr: 100 * max by (host, gpu, gpu_name) (gdc_nvidia_memory_used_bytes{host=~"$host",gpu_name=~"$gpu"}) / max by (host, gpu, gpu_name) (gdc_nvidia_memory_total_bytes{host=~"$host",gpu_name=~"$gpu"})

panels.description: Share of card memory in use. A loaded model holds its memory while idle.

panels.title: GPU cards
panels.description: One row per card on the hosts that report NVIDIA telemetry.

panels.title: Height spread

defaults.noValue: no chain sample in the window

panels.description: Blocks between the highest and the lowest scraped chain node. It ignores the node filter: it compares the whole monitored set.

panels.title: Blocks behind

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter

panels.description: How far each chain node is behind the highest scraped node.

defaults.noValue: no chain node matches the filter
